name: Sanctimonia Sacrilega: Or Beginning of the Rise
source:
The strange, distorted room again. Don't remember anything and don't know where you are. A strange man in strange mask is talking about very strange things...

[From [url=https://chupcha.itch.io/ssobotr]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
又是那个奇怪、扭曲的房间。什么都不记得，也不知道自己在哪里。一个戴着奇怪面具的陌生男人正在谈论非常奇怪的事情……

[来自[url=https://chupcha.itch.io/ssobotr]Itch.io[/url]]
